Counting-process data with time-varying vaccination

Source: R/prepare.R
counting_process.Rd

Splits each person's follow-up at vaccination, giving (tstart, tstop] intervals with vax_status 0 before and 1 after vaccination. Follow-up ends at reporting (event = 1) or study_end (censored); cases reported after study_end are censored at study_end.

Usage

counting_process(
  cohort,
  study_end = attr(cohort, "study_end"),
  age_breaks = default_age_breaks,
  age_labels = default_age_labels
)

Arguments

cohort

Person-level data from ve_population() or sample_cohort().

study_end

Last day of follow-up.

age_breaks, age_labels

Passed to cut() (left-closed intervals).

Value

A data frame from survival::tmerge() with ind_id, age, age_group, sex, time_of_vaccination, tstart, tstop, event, vax_status.
